title: Giggly ‘Model’ Flirts with Cops After Drunken Hit-And-Run: Police
description:
Bodycam footage shows an Ohio woman getting arrested after an alleged drunk hit-and-run in Beachwood on July 7. Officers responded to a gas station after a caller told police the driver of a black Hyundai had rear-ended them at a stop light. The driver told police he followed the suspect to the gas station after noticing the person was not going to stop. Police quickly responded and arrested Antonette Gibson, 31, who appears in the body camera videos to not take the arrest too seriously. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
